notes.title: Next Major Update Coming In April & Update On The Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers, 

The 3rd major update is currently under development and will come in next month, April!

With 2 major updates already released, we have decided to rearrange our roadmap a little bit and release the 2nd community update before the last faction update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140540/b10ff5d0a83eb8d5cee1284b411d91dae5a6819a.png[/img]

The next major update is going to be a community update and will focus on improving existing contents. There will be new contents as well such as a new companion to unlock, new skills and new equipment. Moreover, we are bringing steam achievements to [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] in the next update! So stay tuned!

As always, there will be a detailed list of changes and new content when the update comes out!

Kamen Yamada

notes.title: Announcing the Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

Thank you for your incredible support! Following [i]Steam Next Fest[/i] and taking into account the feedback we received, we've been diligently improving [b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b] We're delighted to announce that [b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b] is now ready for play.

[h3]Get ready because [b]Dungeon Dungeon![/b] is launching on [b]September 22nd[/b] this year![/h3]

We have decided to release the game as an early access title, which means you can start playing and exploring right away. But that's not all! Throughout the early access period, we'll be continuously adding new content and features based on your valuable feedback.

Stay tuned for more information, including a [b]roadmap[/b] of upcoming updates. We're working hard to make this game even better with your involvement!

Follow us on our social media channels and join our community to be part of the journey. Thank you for your support, and see you on September 22nd!

Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114380/Dungeon_Dungeon/

Discord: https://discord.gg/xEQtNZFHb2

Twitter: https://twitter.com/DungeonNDungeon
